welcome.transcript: Welcome Hygiene Hero. Pick a mission to beat the tiny troublemakers.
welcome.expected: Welcome, Hygiene Hero! Pick a mission to beat the tiny troublemakers.

suds-intro.transcript: Germ tiny trouble is hiding on these hands. Let's use our soap shield.
suds-intro.expected: Germ Tiny-Trouble is hiding on these hands. Let's use our soap shield!

wet.transcript: First, get the hands wet. Tap the water drop.
wet.expected: First, get the hands wet. Tap the water drop.

palms.transcript: Rub the palms together in bubbly circles.
palms.expected: Rub the palms together in bubbly circles.

backs.transcript: Flip over, scrub the backs of both hands.
backs.expected: Flip over. Scrub the backs of both hands.

between.transcript: Slide the bubbles between every finger.
between.expected: Slide the bubbles between every finger.

nails.transcript: Scratch the fingertips on the palm to clean under the nails.
nails.expected: Scratch the fingertips on the palm to clean under the nails.

rinse.transcript: Rinse the bubbles away. Bye bye, tiny troublemakers.
rinse.expected: Rinse the bubbles away. Bye-bye, tiny troublemakers!

suds-cheer.transcript: Suds shield complete! Clean hands help keep you ready for fun!
suds-cheer.expected: Suds Shield complete! Clean hands help keep you ready for fun.

smile-intro.transcript: Cavity monsters love leftover food bits. Let's make this smile sparkle.
smile-intro.expected: Cavity Monsters love leftover food bits. Let's make this smile sparkle!

paste.transcript: Use a pea-sized dot of fluoride toothpaste.
paste.expected: Use a pea-sized dot of fluoride toothpaste.

fronts.transcript: Make gentle little circles on the fronts of the teeth.
fronts.expected: Make gentle little circles on the fronts of the teeth.

tops.transcript: Brush the chewing tops where snacks like to hide.
tops.expected: Brush the chewing tops where snacks like to hide.

insides.transcript: sweep gently around the inside of the teeth.
insides.expected: Sweep gently around the insides of the teeth.

tongue.transcript: Give the tongue a gentle brush too.
tongue.expected: Give the tongue a gentle brush, too.

floss.transcript: A grown-up can help floss the tiny spaces between teeth.
floss.expected: A grown-up can help floss the tiny spaces between teeth.

two-by-two.transcript: in real life brush for two full minutes, two times a day.
two-by-two.expected: In real life, brush for two full minutes, two times a day.

smile-cheer.transcript: Smile shield complete. The bright smile sent the cavity monster's packing.
smile-cheer.expected: Smile Shield complete! The bright smile sent the Cavity Monsters packing!

nudge.transcript: Follow the glowing spot. Your hero tool knows the way.
nudge.expected: Follow the glowing spot. Your hero tool knows the way.

keep-scrubbing.transcript: Super bubbles! Keep moving until all the bubble lights shine!
keep-scrubbing.expected: Super bubbles! Keep moving until all the bubble lights shine.

keep-brushing.transcript: Sparkle power. Keep the brush moving in gentle circles.
keep-brushing.expected: Sparkle power! Keep the brush moving in gentle circles.

finale.transcript: Double Hero Power, clean hands and a sparkling smile make a mighty team.
finale.expected: Double hero power! Clean hands and a sparkling smile make a mighty team.
